page.layout: One column of text, centred heading above it; the first paragraph is Latin in italic, followed by a French paragraph opening with a large woodcut-style initial D. No margin notes, no page number, no running head visible.

main_text.head: Epistola Dedicatoria.

p.i: laudem mereatur viri sanƈti consulti & judicij, quo nihil subaƈtius, nihil defæcatius; & per quem, si Viro fides esset apud Mundi Principes & Christianorum Antistites, conquiescerent omnes Controversiæ circa religionem. Sed nunc à Romana ad Gallicam descendo, ut à Cothurno ad soccum.

main_text.p: DE tous les hommes de mérite avec qui j'ay eu quelque commerce, tant deca que delà la Mer, je n'en connois point qui ait l'esprit plus éclairé, plus net, & mieux tourné, que vous

page.notes: The initial D of the French paragraph is a large woodcut-style letter, joined to "E tous" as printed ("DE tous"). Some words in the Latin are faint; the long s is rendered as plain s. The heading "Epistola Dedicatoria." is printed at the top and is taken as the page heading. Light show-through from the reverse side is present and omitted.
